pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Highly irregular, multi-angled dark regions with sharp, jagged edge gradients. The shapes are predominantly complex polygons of varying spatial areas, with many displaying stellate or dendritic extensions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored pathways form an intricate, continuous topological web. Intersection nodes are frequent, often connecting three to five pathways. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, widening at junction nodes and narrowing along longer straight segments.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background along the upper neck and shoulder, appearing as a dense, dark fringe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several distinct, parallel vertical linear marks or scars are visible across the mid-to-upper flank, causing localized textural disruption and interruption of the standard patch-and-corridor pattern.
